about: Eight free accords from Dupe Hacking's 'Fragrance accord formulas' article, read on 2026-10-16. Composed by perfumers in the fragrance.drama community, credited in each accord's style line.
Parts add up to 100. Where a line has a dilution, the parts refer to the solution (10 parts of vanillin at 10% hold 1 part vanillin).
The site's robots.txt allows AI use with citation; each accord links to the article and its own page. Dupe Hacking's other accords need an account or purchase, so they're not included.
Demonstration formulas from dsm-firmenich's free 'Sharing Innovation' brochures (2016, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025), read on 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-18.
Each brochure shows its featured ingredients in formulas by Firmenich perfumers. Only ingredient lists and amounts are copied; each formula links to its page in the PDF.
Formulas were read from the PDF text where every line adds up to the printed total of 1000; the rest were transcribed from the page images and checked the same way.

Where a brochure prints several versions of a formula side by side, the version with the featured ingredient is included and the others are described in its note. Formulas a later brochure repeats (same formula number) are included once.
Amounts printed as 0 are traces that round to zero in the brochure.
Fraterworks' free demonstration formulas, read from their PDFs on 2026-10-14.
Only the ingredient lists and amounts are copied; each formula links back to its PDF (and blog post where there is one).
Fraterworks: formulas are a guide only, used at the maker's own risk, and have not been tested for IFRA compliance.
Six PDFs are scanned images; those were read with OCR and checked against the page image by eye.
Some PDFs' printed TOTAL differs from the sum of their lines; the lines are kept as printed.
Free accords and bases from PerfumerHQ's 'Accords & Base Formulas' page, read on 2026-10-16. Amounts are parts per 1000 by weight.
PerfumerHQ describes them as tested formulas synthesised from cross-referenced industry sources. Only material lists and amounts are copied; each links back to the site.
Every formula adds up to its printed total.
Free educational accords from Scent Inventory, read on 2026-10-16. Amounts are percentages of the accord.
Only material lists and shares are copied; each links back to its page, which has the scent profile and tips.
Three accords (Marine Ozone, Pear, Tobacco) add up to less than 100% on the site itself; they're kept as published.
